newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ceramica Carabobo upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ceramica Carabobo upped.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said on Wednesday it had raised its rating on Venezuelan construction materials company Ceramica Carabobo to buy from neutral.

-- "We believe that the stock's performance will be fueled by its well-balanced exposure to three key areas of the Venezuelan economy: consumption (early-cycle), construction (mid-cycle) and planned volume increases at state oil giant PdVSA (1997-2005)," analyst Julie Dykstra wrote.

-- Bear Stearns is raising its estimates "to reflect our expectations of rebounding growth in the Venezuelan economy in 1997-98 as well as better-than-expected performance in refractory export volumes."
